"Galvas un astes" - iecienītākais ceļojumu šovs dažādu seju, dzimumu un vecumu ceļotājiem. Viena pilsēta un divi vadītāji. Bet vienam no viņiem ir simts dolāru, kas paredzēti visām izklaidēm, bet otram ir zelta bankas karte. Tas ir monētas metiens. Jūs esat miljonārs vai nabags. Jūs dzīvojat greznā dzīvoklī vai guļat hostelī. Jūs pusdienojat augstas klases restorānā vai paēdat pieticīgā ātrās ēdināšanas ēstuvē. Taču zelta karte nenozīmē neaizmirstamas brīvdienas. Dažkārt pietiek pat ar simts dolāriem, lai ceļojums būtu neaizmirstams uz visiem laikiem.

Sabrukusi ofisu ēka, un traģiskajā negadījumā brīnumainā kārtā izdevies izdzīvot jaunai sievietei Meganai. Viņu nomoka neizskaidrojams drudzis. Hauss, palicis bez komandas, mēģina saprast, kas viņai kaiš. Tā kā Hauss pieradis strādāt komandā, viņš palīgā ņem apkopēju, ar kuru aprunāties, taču ātri vien saprot, ka darbs bez atbalsta komandas viņam lāgi nepadodas.

Hauss sāk atsijāt savas jaunās komandas kandidātus. Pēc palīdzības pie Hausa griežas kaujas pilote Grēta, NASA astronautu apmācības programmas kandidāte, kas cieš no neiroloģiskiem traucējumiem - viņai skaņas pārvēršas vizuālos attēlos. Saprotot, ka NASA noraidīs viņas kandidatūru, ja to uzzinās, Grēta lūdz Hausu neatklāt viņas noslēpumu nevienam.

Kurš gan nezina Reksi - lielisko policistu palīgu. Nu iepazīstieties ar Aleksu! Vācu aitu suns Alekss ir labākais izmeklētājs visā Polijas policijā. Tomēr pēc Aleksa drauga un kolēģa nāves policistu starpā rodas šaubas, vai suns spēs pārvarēt lielās sirdssāpes. Par laimi, jaunais komisārs Mareks Bromskis spēj iekarot viņa uzticību, un suņu puika atkal luncina asti un ir gatavs mesties noziedzniekiem pa pēdām. Alekss pat sadraudzējas ar Mareka izveicīgo kolēģi Lūsiju, kura ir nesen šķīrusies un viena audzina savus dvīņu puikas. Policijā darba netrūkst nekad, un ar Aleksu pie sāniem Mareks un viņa komanda ir gatavi stāties pretī jebkuram pārbaudījumam.

Aizraujošs ceļojumu raidījums, kas aicina izbraukāt pasaules iespaidīgākos un neaizmirstamākos vilcienu maršrutus. Raidījuma galvenais varonis ir vilciens - tas ved cauri elpu aizraujošām ainavām, vēsturiskām pilsētām un nomaļiem reģioniem, kur pārvietošanās pa sliedēm nav tikai, lai nokļūtu no viena punkta līdz otram - tas ir īsts piedzīvojums. Raidījums apvieno ainaviskus skatus, kultūras stāstus un dzelzceļa vēsturi, ļaujot atklāt gan pasaulslavenus, gan mazāk zināmus maršrutus, pa ceļam iepazīstot vietējās tradīcijas, cilvēkus paradumus, arhitektūru un inženiertehniskos risinājumus, kas padara katru braucienu unikālu.

Erudīcijas spēle katram darbdienu vakaram! Katru vakaru 15 jautājumi, viens uzvarētājs un 150 eiro balva. Spēli vada radio personība, dīdžejs un pasākumu vadītājs Magnuss Eriņš, bet par vakara erudītākā cilvēka titulu sacenšas divi dalībnieki. Noteikumi ir pavisam vienkārši - katram dalībniekam priekšā ir poga, kas kļūst aktīva, līdzko izskanējis jautājums. Kurš pirmais šo pogu nospiež, tas izvēlas jautājuma likteni - vai pats vēlas uz to atbildēt cerībā nopelnīt divus punktus, vai arī pirmo iespēju dot konkurentam, lai pats pēc tam mēģinātu tikt pie viena punkta. Kurš atbildējis pirmais un pareizi, tas tiek pie diviem punktiem, kurš otrais - pie viena, bet par nepareizu atbildi punkti nepienākas. Kuram vakara beigās vairāk punktu, tas arī uzvarētājs! Uzvarētājs saņem 150 eiro balvu un iespēju piedalīties nākamā vakara spēlē.
Sadursme 360 ir 10 minūšu ikdienas operatīvo drošības dienestu ziņu raidījums ar galveno uzsvaru uz ceļu satiksmes drošību.

Erudīcijas un taktikas spēlē "Viens pret visiem" spēles dalībnieki stāsies duelī ar zināmām Latvijas personībām, katram liekot galdā savu trumpi - slavenībām talkā būs erudīti eksperti, bet pretiniekam - pirmais gājiens un iespēja taktiski izvēlēties tēmas, tostarp sev neērtākos jautājumus piespēlējot slavenībai. Katrā spēlē būs jauns spēlētājs, bet sabiedrībā zināmās personības komanda būs nemainīga visu nedēļu. Par spēles tempu, azartu un jautājumiem savukārt parūpēsies Gustavs Terzens. Kurš no dalībniekiem savu trumpi izspēlēs gudrāk? Vai uzvaru izšķirs zināšanas, taktika vai spēja riskēt īstajā brīdī?

Garšīgais ciemošanās šovs "Gandrīz ideālas vakariņas" atkal priecē skatītājus! Četri dalībnieki nedēļas garumā cits pie cita viesosies, gatavos vakariņas un centīsies pārsteigt ar gardiem ēdieniem, radošām idejām un īpašu vakara noskaņu. Taču ne vienmēr viss noritēs pēc plāna - amizanti starpgadījumi un negaidīti pārsteigumi būs daļa no vakariņu šarma. Šova jaunajā sezonā savas mājokļu durvis vērs sabiedrībā zināmas personības, bet katra vakara noslēgumā viesi vērtēs gan ēdienus, gan radīto gaisotni. Pēc četriem vakariem augstāko punktu skaitu ieguvušais dalībnieks kļūs par nedēļas uzvarētāju un saņems vērtīgu balvu. Skatītājus sagaida sirsnīgas tikšanās, humors, pārsteigumi un iespēja ielūkoties iemīļotu personību ikdienā - šoreiz nevis uz skatuves vai ekrānā, bet pie vakariņu galda.

Leipcigas policijas īpašā vienība SOKO - labākie no labākajiem, augstas klases profesionāļi, izmeklētāji, kas ķeras pie darba, lai atrisinātu smagākos un sarežģītākos pilsētā paveiktos noziegumus. Vienību vada ambiciozā vecākā policijas komisāre Ina Cimermane, kas kopā ar savu uzticamo komandu Janu Meibahu, Tomu Kovalski un Olīviju Faredi izmeklē smagus noziegumus - gan rūpīgi plānotas slepkavības, gan emociju karstumā paveiktas. Lai notvertu noziedzniekus, komanda piesaista valsts izcilākos ekspertus un labākos konsultantus.

Uz ielas norisinās apšaude, kas nogalina deviņgadīgu meitenīti, kura atrodas mājā, savā gultiņā. Nogalinātā ir Vorika tuva drauga meita, un vainīgā atrašanā viņš ļaujas emocijām. Tikmēr Niks izmeklē lietu, kad darba vietā nogalināts kāds tehnoloģiju uzņēmuma direktors, viņa nāvi vēlējušies gandrīz visi darbinieki, bet neviens nekā nav redzējis.

Ieskaties vienas no Austrālijas lielākās un noslogotākās medicīnas iestādes, Melburnas Karaliskās slimnīcas, neatliekamās palīdzības nodaļas ikdienā. Nežēlīgi uzbrukumi, šausminošas avārijas, traumatiski negadījumi un katastrofas - katru dienu slimnīcā nonāk cilvēki ar dzīvībai bīstamiem ievainojumiem. Tad pie darba ķeras augsti kvalificēti ārsti un medmāsas un nenogurstoši cīnās par savu pacientu dzīvībām. Spriedze, emocijas, brīnumainas izglābšanās un traģiski zaudējumi - aiz šīs slimnīcas sienām notiek it viss. Sāpju asaras mijas ar laimīgiem smaidiem.

Ceļotāji turpina iepazīt zilo ezeru zemi Latgali. Otrā diena dziedātājas Alises Haijimas rokās, viņa četrotni uzsēdinās zirga mugurā un ar savu aktivitāti, viesošanās šmakovkas muzejā, krietni ietekmēs jautrās kompānijas pašsajūtu nākamajā dienā. Bet vai tu zini, kā latgaliski skan: "Es tevi mīlu, tu būsim mans vergs!" ?

Slavenā NCIS Losandželosas īpašā vienība ķeras pie darba! Augsti kvalificēti, pieredzējuši un spējīgi - viņi tiek piesaistīti lietās, kurās uz spēles ir valsts drošība. Komandu vada augumā necilā, tomēr ļoti spējīgā Hetija, kuras apskaužamās zināšanas, skarbā attieksme un ciešais skatiens iedveš bailes kā noziedzniekiem, tā viņas padotajiem. Īpašais aģents Džī Kalens iepriekš stradājis FIB, Narkotiku apkarošanas administrācijā un Centrālajā izlūkošanas pārvaldē, bet viņa pārinieks Sems Hanna ir ar militāru un sporta pieredzi, un kopā ar savu uzticamo komandu viņi ir neapturami un spēj aizturēt pat visrūdītākos noziedzniekus.

Īpašā izmeklētāju vienība detektīva Maka Teilora vadībā šķetina noziegumus tumšākajos Ņujorkas nostūros. Viņi ir kā savdabīga ģimene, kurus vieno spēcīga taisnīguma izjūta. Lai atklātu sarežģītās krimināllietas, viņi izmanto progresīvākās metodes, pretstatā tradicionālajiem izmeklēšanas paņēmieniem. Katra ir lieta kā rēbuss, kuru komanda risina, analizējot katru detaļu un pavedienu.

"Gandrīz ideālas vakariņas" šonedēļ turpinās ar aktieri Kasparu Zāli, kurš pie sevis ciemos uzņems bārmeni Mārtiņu Rozenvaldu, rakstnieci Daci Rukšāni un realitātes šova "Ģimene burkā" dalībnieci Vitu Valteri. Savu vakaru Kaspars būs izplānojis īpaši rūpīgi - galda klājumam viņš izvēlējies neparastus dabas materiālus, kurus pats devies meklēt un zvejot ezerā. Taču Dace Rukšāne, izmantojot savas bioķīmijas zināšanas, atklās, ka ēst no šādām lapām nemaz neesot tik veselīgi. Arī ēdiena gatavošana Kasparam sagādās ne vienu vien jautājumu - vai burgera kotlete ar kadiķogām patiešām būs tāda, kā iecerēts? Lai vakars būtu jautrāks, viesiem nāksies iekustināt gurnus deju ritmos, bet noslēgumā vakariņu saimnieks parūpēsies arī par gardu un saldu vakara izskaņu.
Sadursme 360 ir 10 minūšu ikdienas operatīvo drošības dienestu ziņu raidījums ar galveno uzsvaru uz ceļu satiksmes drošību.

360 Ziņas ir dinamisks un mūsdienīgs TOP7 dienas svarīgāko Latvijas un pasaules notikumu apskats, kas palīdz saprast, kāpēc tas ir svarīgi tieši tev. TOP7 apvieno ātru tempu, saprotamu valodu, dažādus viedokļus un cilvēku pieredzes, kā arī skaidrojošu pieeju bez informācijas pārslodzes un liekvārdības, palīdzot orientēties informatīvajā troksnī un īsā laikā ar TOP7 iegūt skaidru priekšstatu par dienas būtiskāko.

Kad policija ir bezspēcīga, palīgā dodas Īpašā izmeklēšanas aģentūra SLED. Tā ir īpaši izveidota struktūra policijas galvenās pārvaldes sastāvā un tieši pakļauta ģenerālim - Ukrainas Iekšlietu ministra vietniekam. Vienība nodarbojas ar īpaši skaļu, sarežģītu un smagu noziegumu izmeklēšanu. Tai pieejamas vismodernākās tehnoloģijas un valsts labākie kriminālisti un tiesu medicīnas laboratorijas. Protams, vienībā darbojas arī tikai labākie operatīvie darbinieki, kuri nepieļaus, ka kāda lieta netiktu atrisināta. Galvenajās lomās: Tatjana Kravčenko, Boriss Georgijevskijs, Aleksejs Surovcevs.

Bijusī izmeklētāja Nataļja Dzjubenko un žurnālists Vadims Zorons turpina cīņu taisnības vārdā! Kopā ar saviem profesionālajiem palīgiem viņi izmeklē sevišķi smagus un sarežģītus noziegumus, kuru atšķetināšanā likumsargi izrādījušies bezspēcīgi. Aiz restēm mūža ieslodzījumu izcieš nežēlīgs maniaks Marks Šimičs, kurš saviem upuriem lika izvēlēties - izdarīt pašnāvību vai mirt mokošā bada nāvē. Nu kāds pastrādā noziegumus, kopējot Šimiču. Vadims dodas uz cietumu, lai tuvāk iepazītu maniaku un atrastu saikni starp abiem noziedzniekiem un notvertu ļaundari. Tā kā katrs izmeklētājs ir ar savu spēcīgu raksturu, tādu pat viedokli, un katram ir savas darba metodes, atmosfēra komandā gan kļūst nokaitēta, un sastrādāties nav nemaz tik viegli.

Nepālas ceļojums var sākties! Jau pirmajā sērijā dosimies uz visnotaļ bīstamu savvaļas vietu - Nepālas džungļiem, kur pārsteigumi gaida ik uz soļa! Raidījumā uzzināsiet, kā izvērtīsies saldās medus medības pie milzu asinskārajām bitēm un kā ar masveidīgu rituālu palīdzību iespējams apturēt sausumu, kā arī dosimies uz grandiozām svinībām Himalajos. Bet Dmitrijs Komarovs būs liecinieks nežēlīgam rituālam, kas šokēs līdz sirds dziļumiem. Kāpēc cilvēki joprojām upurē dievus, lūdzot viņiem aizsardzību un palīdzību? To uzzini piedzīvojumiem bagātajā un ekstrēmajā Nepālas ceļojumā!

Maša un Maksims atkal dodas prom - šoreiz uz Nīderlendi, atstājot nu jau septiņus gadus veco Žeņu Mašas vecāku - priecīgo lauku ļaužu - uzraudzībā. Tomēr nepaiet ne diena, kad ciemā ierodas arī smalkie un vīzdegunīgie Maksima vecāki - viņi vēlas mīļoto mazmeitiņu sagatavot skolai, kā arī nedomā pieļaut, ka Mašas vecāki saņems Žeņas nedalītu uzmanību. Žeņa ir jau pietiekoši liela, lai saprastu - šīs vasaras galvenais uzdevums būs uzturēt mieru mājās. Vai mazai meitenei izdosies šķietami neiespējamais - samierināt nesamierināmos?

Krimināli dokumentāls drāmas seriāls, kurā tiek izmeklēti sarežģīti kriminālprocesi. Katra sērija ir atsevišķs stāsts, kas balstīts uz reāliem notikumiem. Daudzi šādi noziegumi varētu palikt neatklāti un vainīgais – izvairīties no soda, ja vien izmeklētāja atklātā detaļa nekļūtu par pavedienu uz atrisinājumu: nomesta matu sprādze, pazaudēta poga vai ielikta zīmīte - lietiskie pierādījumi.

Andrejs Kravecs ir godprātīgs un principiāls operatīvais darbinieks. Tieši viņa godprātība noved pie saķeršanās ar augsti stāvošu un ietekmīgu politiķi, kurš saniknojas ne pa jokam. Lai pasargātu Andreju no neparedzamām sekām, vadība pārceļ viņu no galvaspilsētas uz dzimto Odesu. Dzimtajā pilsētā Andreju jau sagaida seni draugi – bijušais bokseris Fedja, kurš nerunā daudz, bet ir uzticams līdz kaulam, un Makss – talantīgs inženieris un programmētājs. Un šī komanda noliks pie vietas ne vienu vien Odesas noziedznieku!

Kad policija ir bezspēcīga, palīgā dodas Īpašā izmeklēšanas aģentūra SLED. Tā ir īpaši izveidota struktūra policijas galvenās pārvaldes sastāvā un tieši pakļauta ģenerālim - Ukrainas Iekšlietu ministra vietniekam. Vienība nodarbojas ar īpaši skaļu, sarežģītu un smagu noziegumu izmeklēšanu. Tai pieejamas vismodernākās tehnoloģijas un valsts labākie kriminālisti un tiesu medicīnas laboratorijas. Protams, vienībā darbojas arī tikai labākie operatīvie darbinieki, kuri nepieļaus, ka kāda lieta netiktu atrisināta. Galvenajās lomās: Tatjana Kravčenko, Boriss Georgijevskijs, Aleksejs Surovcevs.

Ieskaties noziedzības pasaulē, kur divas leģendāras komandas no seriāliem "Ūdens policija" un "Izmeklēšanas aģentūra "SLED"" apvieno spēkus, lai izmeklētu vissarežģītākos noziegumus. Šī pieredzes, zināšanu un tehnoloģiju apvienošanās kļūs par īstu izaicinājumu noziedzīgajai pasaulei. Stāsts sākas ar izmeklēšanu par vairākām skaļām ārvalstu pilsoņu slepkavībām, kas vienlaikus notikušas Karpatu reģionā un Kijevā. Vēstnieki un konsuli pieprasīja nekavējoties savervēt labākos spēkus. Detektīviem darbā palīdzēs jaudīga uz mākslīgā intelekta bāzes veidota datorprogramma K.O.D. Tā ne tikai risina sarežģītas noziedznieku mīklas, bet arī nolasa izmeklēšanas dalībnieku emocionālo stāvokli.

Callie and Jasper develop an uncanny emotional connection to a young orphaned girl they chance upon in a park.

Charlie works for a company that is taken over by Walcott who believes family values are a priority. Career-driven Charlie does a little fibbing when under the pressure of Walcott's standards, and believes she's in the clear. But when Walcott invites himself over for dinner, she borrows her friend's house and daughter and hires actor Buck to play her husband for the evening. The one-night "act" turns into a full-time gig when her boss decides to rent the house next door for the summer, forcing Charlie and Buck to stay together in the fake lifestyle she created.

Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

Mystery with Lea Thompson. DNA evidence and surveillance footage point to a corrupt CEO as the prime suspect in a whistleblower's murder. Jane Doe, however, believes the suspect's twin brother is behind the crime.

Part 1 of 2. The year is 1891 and Wyoming is in its first year of statehood. The three Hammett brothers, Cain, Harry and Dale, find themselves in the middle of a rapidly escalating range war that pits cattle barons against homesteaders.
Western with Burt Reynolds. Three brothers become embroiled in a rapidly escalating range war that pits old time cattle barons against homesteaders.

Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's Sherlock Holmes - the world's greatest detective - faces a most alluring adversary... Legendary opera star Irene Adler is threatening to destroy the King of Bohemia's reputation with proof of their illicit affair. The evidence? A photograph. Her ransom? The king's hand in marriage. But not only does investigating detective Sherlock Holmes already know Irene from the past, he also knows that the queen of manipulation would never resort to such a common crime. After uncovering her true ambitions, Holmes draws the cunning songstress into a well-matched game of cat and mouse.

Blackout is a British TV drama series revolving around a corrupt council official who used to be an idealistic young man. Every new day brings him a new blackout because of alcohol, and sufferings to his family for the same reason. One day he gets his breath and realises he has become a murderer. He wants to tell his dark secret to his lawyer and goes to the court. There he becomes a witness of a shooting and covers an important witness with his own body. He becomes a local hero and people want to see him as the next mayor. He begins a dramatic quest for redemption.

The scientist and novelist John McAdams is summoned to an emergency meeting of scientists at the Preston Point Institute to discuss a tsunami that has hit the Southern New Jersey Shore. Eight years ago, John created man-made tidal waves with his Sea Lion Project; during the experiments, his beloved wife Ann had died and he quit working as scientist. Now the scientists discuss the possibility of a terrorist attack. When John returns home, he finds that someone has planted a file in his computer with classified information to incriminate him since he had written a sci-fi novel about terrorists using tidal waves to destroy the USA. When a second tsunami reaches the Maine, John becomes the prime suspect and is chased by the FBI and the police. Meanwhile he investigates the events with his former colleague and friend Sophie Marleau and when he follows the money, he discloses a huge conspiracy with economical interests of the Camtrell Corporation to construct the Sea Wall defense system to protect the American coast.

Suddenly the US east coast is hit by a type of natural disaster formerly reserved, except after a major earthquake, for the Pacific and Indian ocean rims: tidal waves of the destructive tsunami type. Scientist and fiction author John McAdams attends a national emergency conference which concludes the phenomenon must be man-made, quite possibly abusing the findings of John's secret former Sea Lion project, but who wants to and has the means? Indeed John soon finds himself set-up for a murder and chased. Major destructions mean major contracts for construction and coastal defenses, so building tycoons like Victor Bannister certainly have a considerable interest...

This movie is based on Tim Stoker's experience as a monster movie geek. The monsters in an old non released movie come out of the movie and Tim and his friends in the real world and the movie must find a way to stop the monsters. The movie has bullies, geeks, parents, a love intrest, et cetera.

Old enemies, Maggie and Negan, travel to a crumbling, post-apocalyptic Manhattan to fulfill a dangerous mission; filled with the dead and living dwellers, New York City has been transformed into a world full of chaos, danger, terror and beauty.

A former US Operative, who lived in Russia in his earlier years and had been married there with a child, comes out of retirement to face down a former enemy, now running as a candidate for President in modern Russia. Working with a Russian policewoman, they work to uncover a plot to use biological weapons against certain factions of the Russian people to commit genocide. The virus would also be released in other populations, but would be treated making the candidate a hero. A side plot has the agent being reunited with his long lost daughter.

US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

"The Zoo: San Diego" provides a behind the scenes look at the daily lives of various species of animals and the teams that care for them. Featuring two parks, the San Diego Zoo and the San Diego Zoo Safari Park, as well as the San Diego Zoo Institute for Conservation Research, San Diego Zoo Global is home to more than 700 species and 6,500 animals. A wide range of animals are introduced, including pandas, giraffes, Galapagos tortoises, koalas, elephants, mountain lions, two baby cheetahs that are learning how to be ambassadors for their species and a flock of ostriches known as the "Spice Girls." Besides the animals, the keepers and veterinarians at both the Zoo and the Safari Park -- many of whom have dedicated their lives to caring for animals, discuss what it's like to be a part of this world-renowned zoo.

This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

Animal Cops: Philadelphia follows the work of the Pennsylvania SPCA's Humane Law Enforcement team as they investigate cases of animal cruelty; rescue sick and abused animals and fight for justice on their behalf. The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

When one thinks of dominant animals that roam the earth, large predators - lions, grizzlies and titanic anacondas come to mind. But, pound for pound, the most powerful and awe-inspiring creatures are the elusive micro-monsters that exist just beneath our feet. Wildlife author & expert Bradley Trevor Greive and biodesigner Billy Almon venture to some of the most remote and inhospitable habitats in the world to track down these tiny beasts. Using state of the art equipment, they will measure the abilities of these creatures and present them in a way never seen before.

Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

Total DramaRama is canadian animated comedy series, spin-off of Total Drama, all characters are already well-known and loved by the audience. This time Duncan, Gwen, Courtney, Izzy, Noah, Bridgette and the rest find themselves in the past as kids and their adventures take place in kindergarten. The strict Chef Hatchet is there to keep his eye on them. Any harmless idea of the kids turns out to be a total disaster, they are irrepressible in producing new ideas on how to have fun. the kids are discussing every single decision and plan in front of the cameras just like their adult versions, being a part of a reality show.

Drew Pritchard and Paul Cowland travel across the United Kingdom to uncover classic cars to buy, restore and sell on for a profit. The pair scour garages, barns and facilities to discover collectible cars which include the likes of the Morris Minor Traveller, Jaguar XJS, Rover P6 and a BMW 635 CSI among many others. The combination of Drew's expertise of negotiation and deal-making and Paul's extensive mechanical knowledge makes them a formidable team ready to tackle anything challenging that comes their way.

Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland.

Motorbike enthusiast Henry Cole and expert Sam Lovegrove travel around the UK to explore people's sheds searching for some automotive bargains. They purchase all kinds of old cars, bikes, jeeps, tractors and other vehicles in order to renovate them and sell after the rehabilitation work is over. The old vehicles are restored and given second life. It is a risky business and the two always wonder if they manage to make profit this time.

For many, an ideal existence is as far away from the bustling boulevards and city streets as is physically possible, opting to live in a serene and secluded corner of our planet. This documentary series follows teams of adventuring builders as they construct magnificent and unique properties in far-flung corners of our planet. Battling against adverse conditions, limited budgets and narrow deadlines, these crews strive to get their structures erected in time. From mountain cabins to woodland yurts, shipping container homes to lighthouse conversions, these stunning properties show the true meaning of living off the grid.

Meet the unconventional Tweto family that rules Alaska's most dangerous skies. Operating their family-run airline, Era Alaska, they battle unforgiving Alaskan weather and terrain to transport life's necessities to one of the most remote and extreme regions of America. With no freeway system for hundreds of miles, Era Alaska is the lifeline for the isolated rural inhabitants of the Bering Sea coastline. From champion snow dogs bound for the Iditarod to medicine for sick children to groceries for miners working on an operation on the North Slope, the goods that the intrepid pilots ship on any given day are crucial to everyday life.

p.t: Insane Pools Off the Deep End
p.d: Insane Pools: Off the Deep End is a home improvement show that follows pool designer Lucas Congdon and his team from Lucas Lagoons. Congdon and his crew renovate existing pools and build new ones on residential properties. Thanks to their unbelievable imagination, creativity and professionalism they can turn every pool into an ultimate backyard oasis for a whole family and transform it into a natural lagoon. They prefer working with hand-selected stones from Tennessee.

In Barcelona, Mike and Elvis try to restore a SEAT 600, but an unexpected breakdown and some nasty bills put the boys' profit margin in peril.

In Texas, four competing car dealers, JD Cole, Martha Davis, Ash Rabah, and Tommy Spagnola, battle it out to get the best deals and profits for their businesses. The cars bought, fixed-up and sold on range from many different eras, brands and variants. Some of which include classic muscle cars such as the Pontiac Trans Am and Chevrolet El Camino, to European cults like the Alfa Romeo Spider, Mercedes SL and Volkswagen Beetle. The aim of the game is to get the cars at knock-down prices, restore them to former glory and flip them for a healthy profit. Find out which dealer comes out on top.

RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ - experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

The team explores a former psychiatric hospital with a dark reputation. Using forensics techniques, they learn that the rumors about the horrors in the "suicide bathroom" are true. Later, Pat and Lisa discover an amorous spirit in the File Room, while Mark and Malinka hear a growl on the third floor. Lisa unexpectedly finds herself experiencing the depression and despair of the former patients at St. Albans even after she's back home and must turn to her fellow investigators for help.

Westward ho! We settle in Salt Lake City, where we learn about Bringham Young's settlement of the Utah territory and his monument at This is the Place Park. Then we dig in the dirt to find hundreds of perfectly preserved dinosaurs at the Utah Natural History museum. We'll take a look at some US aviation history at the Hill Air force Base museum, and see how life was like for the Utah pioneers at Frontier Homestead State Park.

Travel Thru History (or TTH for short) is a new educational/informational (E/I) series designed to spark interest and enthusiasm in viewers to learn about our country's rich and fascinating history by traveling to diverse locales across the US. While it is targeted to a teen audience, the entire family will enjoy watching TTH. Videotaped and edited in the style of other popular, educational programming like Modern Marvels, Travel Thru History is the latest television series co-developed by The Television Syndication Company and Red 5 Creative.

What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature's Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash.

Weather is universal and it's also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth's crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo's Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.
Running Southbound outside on Central Coast with a big Tyee Chinook Release finish North of Milbanke Sound!

Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world - something that starts with simply getting out of town!

Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it. In this series of 20 films, of 26 minutes each, the habitat will be a major showcase revealing our capacity to adapt ourselves at a time where we need to find solutions in order to address immense changes.

Gamače ir pārliecināts, ka viņš tuvojas Jūlijas slepkavības noslēpuma atrisināšanai. Kevinam un Lakostam ir spraiga satikšanās sastapšanās. Kevins mēģina sevi aizstāvēt, sakot, ka ir no malas apzināti iejaukts slepkavības lietā.

Izmeklētāju darbā pirmās 48 stundas pēc slepkavības izdarīšanas ir visbūtiskākās, jo tieši šis laikposms nereti izšķir to, vai noziegums tiks atšķetināts. Vēlāk izmeklētāju izredzes notvert vainīgo var sarukt pat uz pusi. Raidījums ļauj ielūkoties ASV slepkavību izmeklētāju ikdienā, kuri neatlaidīgi strādā, lai jau pirmajās nozieguma izdarīšanas stundās atklātu pēc iespējas vairāk detaļu par ļaunprātības apstākļiem. Skatītājus sagaida reāls izmeklēšanas process, liecinieku intervijas, kriminālistiskās ekspertīzes aizkulises un iespēja ielūkoties vietās, kur nupat pastrādāts noziegums.
Pēc filmu skatīšanās nakts 18 gadus vecā Zoja Kamposa nav atrodama. Izmeklētāji pārmeklē viņas Facebook kontu un atklāj, ka viņa nebūt nepārradās laicīgi, kā viņas mīļotie līdz tam uzskatīja.

Nekas neliecina par iespējamām briesmām, kad Džons F. Kenedijs 1963. gada 22. novembrī ierodas Dalasā, kur viņu silti sagaida Teksasas iedzīvotāji. Pulksten 12.29, vien 60 sekundes pirms pirmā šāviena, valsts pirmais pāris smaida un māj apmeklētājiem. Taču tad atskan šāviens, kas netrāpa mērķī, toties izraisa haosu. Nav saprotams, no kurienes šauts. Otrais un trešais šāviens prezidentam izrādās liktenīgi. Amerikas Savienoto Valstu prezidents ir nogalināts tūkstošiem aculiecinieku priekšā.

Ceļā uz lidostu 19 gadus vecā Keitlina Akensa negaidīti piestāj Virdžīnijas tirdzniecības centrā un… pazūd. Policija veic izmeklēšanu par viņas mīļotajiem un sāk aizdomās turēt kādu no pazudušās tuvajiem, kas varētu zināt vairāk nekā saka.

Pēc vienas kārtējām sestdienām Bads parādās jaunā TV iepazīšanās spēļu šovā mazāk pieredzējušajiem "You Can't Miss". Tiesa, ne ar gaidītajiem rezultātiem. Kellija ar savu zemo IQ uzskata, ka pastāv sazvērestība, lai viņai neļautu uzzināt, kas šodien par dienu.
Als nolemj kā vecāka gadagājuma pilsonis lēti iekļūt kino, un pēkšņi apjauš, ka viņš paliek vecs. Pēc tam viņš sāk uzvesties senili, bet kāds notikums viņu atgriež realitātē.

Kāda Amerikas uzņēmuma reģionālais menedžeris Maikls Skots ir neprecējies vīrietis pusmūža gados. Viņš ir pārliecināts, ka ir ofisa lielākais jokpēteris, biznesa guru un labs visu darbinieku draugs. Maikls pat nenojauš, ka pārējie viņu uzskata par diezgan aprobežotu tipu un izturas iecietīgi tikai tādēļ, ka viņš parakstās uz algas čekiem. Ofisa biroja administratore ir draudzīgā un saprātīgā Pema Bīslija, kas ik dienas spiesta paciest Maikla citu par citu vājprātīgākās idejas. Pemas patīkamākā dienas daļa saistās ar Džimu Halpertu, jauku puisi ar lielisku humora izjūtu (turklāt Džims ir līdz ausīm iemīlējies Pemā). Ofisā strādā arī Dvaits Štrūts, iedomīgs reģionālā menedžera asistents, Raiens Hovards - jauns, gudrs, ar sevi pārņemts vīrietis, kā arī citi kolorīti tēli. Ironisks, melns un skarbi tiešs gudra humora cienītājiem - tāds ir seriāls "Ofiss.

Ofisa biroja administratore ir draudzīgā un saprātīgā Pema Bīslija, kas ik dienas spiesta paciest Maikla citu par citu vājprātīgākās idejas. Pemas patīkamākā dienas daļa saistās ar Džimu Halpertu, jauku puisi ar lielisku humora izjūtu (turklāt Džims ir līdz ausīm iemīlējies Pemā). Ofisā strādā arī Dvaits Štrūts, iedomīgs reģionālā menedžera asistents, Raiens Hovards - jauns, gudrs, ar sevi pārņemts vīrietis, kā arī citi kolorīti tēli. Ironisks, melns un skarbi tiešs gudra humora cienītājiem - tāds ir seriāls "Ofiss.

Kad Džūlsa jūt, ka draudzenes sāk atsvešināties, viņa atdzīvina viņu izdomāto draudzības svētku tradīciju - Līdzatkarības dienu. Medisone satuvinās ar savu draudzeni Rūbiju, neraugoties uz Džūlsas skepsi. Stella cenšas pierādīt Livai savu uzticību.

Draudzenes atbrīvo vietu jaunām lietām gan skapjos, gan dzīvē. Džūlsa un Izija nejauši satiek bijušo kolēģi. Izijas nedrošība sasniedz kulmināciju. Stella mēģina atrast kopīgu valodu ar Livu un viņas dēlu. Džūlsa un Medisone dodas dubultrandiņā.
Seriāla galvenie varoņi ir seši draugi - Reičela, Monika, Fēbe, Džoijs, Čendlers un Ross, kuri dzīvo kaimiņos un regulāri nonāk aizraujošās un ļoti komiskās situācijās.

В небольшом городке у польского приграничья, где во время полномасштабного вторжения России в Украину развернули полевой госпиталь, бок о бок трудятся украинские медики, волонтёры и квалифицированные специалисты из Израиля, Польши, США и других стран. Они оставили свою мирную жизнь ради того, чтобы спасать людей, пострадавших от войны. Каждый день здесь — это сочетание тяжёлых вызовов и веры в лучшее. Среди пациентов есть и военные, мужественно защищающие Украину, и мирные жители, каждый со своей нередко основанной на реальности историей. В этом месте, среди отголосков войны, продолжается жизнь: здесь появляются на свет дети, а порой — даже возникает любовь, несмотря на все испытания.

Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

Успешная бизнес-леди Катя узнает, что её дочь пыталась покончить жизнь самоубийством. Как оказалось, не впервые. Чтобы быть ближе к дочери и понять, чем на самом деле занимаются дети в школе, она начинает работать учительницей экономики. Молодая мама понятия не имела, какие секреты скрываются за стенами обычной школы. Тогда же в учебное заведение приходит новый преподаватель английского - бывший адвокат и сын директора Алекс. У него есть невеста, которая живет в США, но вдруг между ним и Екатериной промелькнула искра. Впрочем, скелеты прошлого всё ещё дают о себе знать и не отпускают героев...

Все неприятности обрушиваются на Ольгу Грабину в один день: она теряет работу в клинике, узнаёт об измене мужа, а дочери сообщают о совсем неожиданных планах на будущее. Старшая дочь Лера беременна, а младшая Варя мечтает стать актрисой, а не продолжать медицинскую династию, как этого ожидала семья. Пытаясь начать жизнь заново, Ольга должна найти новую работу, поддержать дочерей и научиться принимать их выбор. Но этим её заботы не заканчиваются. Ей предстоит защитить интересы своих детей и не допустить, чтобы любовница мужа получила имущество, которое по праву должно достаться дочерям Ольги. Однако самый сложный вопрос остаётся без ответа: стоит ли разводиться с мужем и двигаться дальше или попытаться спасти брак? Пока Ольга заботится обо всех вокруг, она не замечает самого главного: в её жизни уже появился человек, который способен помочь ей вновь поверить в любовь и подарить долгожданную весну в её сердце.

In Ronny Yu's fast-moving crime-thriller, Samuel L Jackson plays Elmo McElroy, a pharmaceutical genius who has made a fortune in illegal drugs, particularly with Formula 51, which is more potent than heroin and crack. But instead of selling it to his drug lord employer the Lizard (Meatloaf), he flies to Liverpool where Felix (Robert Carlyle) is acting as broker for gangster Leopold Durant (Ricky Tomlinson). Durant is prepared to offer $20m for the formula; money Elmo would love to spend, if he can stay alive long enough.
A 12-year-old disabled boy, whose father recently passed away, has his life changed when the pony he rescues gives birth to a unicorn. Can he save the unicorn from the people who want to exploit it?
A boy rises to the occasion with his best friend (a lovable talking dog) to save his home and family.

p.t: Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding
p.d: The Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding continues the story of 2003's fantasy romance The Prince and Me. In the earlier film, Paige (Julia Stiles) - a midwestern college co-ed - falls in love with Edvard (Luke Mably), sans realizing that he is actually the Prince of Denmark. In this sequel, Paige (now played by neophyte Kam Heskin) and Eddie must confront a centuries-old Danish edict declaring that if a Danish prince marries a commoner, he must abdicate his throne. C

Harriet, a ten-year old girl, lives together with her big sister and her alcoholic mother out in the countryside. The family runs a motel. Harriet is different from the others, as she owns a great creativity and has nobody to play with. Her infinite world exists only in her mind. One day, Ricky comes along. He is a grown-up, but retarded son of an elderly lady. Soon, Harriet and Ricky share their experiences of life from a different point of view and become close friends. But his mother still plans to give Ricky away into professional care in a home, because she won't live forever to be there for him.

In December 1941, Japan expands the occupation of its neighbouring countries to Southeast Asia. The railway from Tianjin to Nanjing in East China became a key military transportation route, heavily guarded by Japanese soldiers. Railroad worker Ma Yuan (Jackie Chan) leads a team of freedom fighters. Using his deep knowledge of the train network, he and his men sabotage it, ambushing Japanese soldiers and stealing supplies to feed the starving Chinese. Although the freedom fighters have no weapons of their own, they employ whatever tools are at hand, including a hammer and shovels, loose railway track planks and diverted trains. The local Chinese call the unlikely heroes the "Railroad Tigers". The freedom fighters find themselves on the wrong side of the tracks when the Japanese send reinforcements to Shandong. In an act of defiance, Ma Yuan launches his most dangerous mission yet, blowing up a heavily guarded railroad bridge. When the Japanese learn of the crippling plan, which will derail the war effort, the stakes are raised even higher. After many missed opportunities and missed shots, the bridge is blown up by the ragtag Chinese railroad tigers.
Facing eviction from his parent's home on his 30th birthday, a socially awkward guy meets the girl of his dreams and creates his own rules for growing up.

p.t: North & South: The Battle of New Market
p.d: Based on a true story of the American Civil War, culminating at the Battle of New Market, May 1864. A group of teenage cadets sheltered from war at the Virginia Military Institute must confront the horrors of an adult world when they are called upon to defend the Shenandoah Valley. Leaving behind their youth, these cadets must decide what they are fighting for.

See You in September is an original romantic comedy set in current day Manhattan. The film centers around Lindsay, a beautiful woman who seemingly has it all, but is deeply afraid of commitment. When she finds out that her therapist takes a vacation for the entire month of August she feels shocked and abandoned. Instead of taking this news lying down, Lindsay enlists the help of her acerbic best friend Monica to come up with a solution. With the assistance of "Craig's List", Lindsay puts together a group therapy session for all Manhattanites who are in need of therapy, but more importantly angry at their therapists for abandoning them.

Cookie's Fortune unfolds over an eventful Easter weekend in the small town of Holly Springs, Mississippi. The town residents are peaceful, kind folk--with the exception of Camille Dixon (Glenn Close) - a pushy theatre director with an incredibly shy younger sister, Cora (Julianne Moore), whose estranged daughter Emma (Liv Tyler) has just returned to town. On the heels of her latest play, Camille is shocked to discover that her Aunt Jewel Mae "Cookie" Orcutt (Patricia Neal) has committed suicide. Terrified at the thought of how this will tarnish the family name, she eats the suicide note to make it look like a burglary. This set-up leads the police to one main suspect, Willis Richland (Charles S. Dutton), who also happens to be Cookie's best friend. Although the rest of the town is convinced Willis didn't commit the crime, an outside investigator (Courtney B. Vance) isn't so sure. As Easter Sunday and opening night of the play arrive, the truth comes out, revealing more secrets than anyone could have possibly imagined.

p.t: That Trip We Took with Dad
p.d: This comedy drama tells the story of a Romanian-German family caught up in the political turmoil of 1968. They start a journey from the city of Arad to the German Democratic Republic, where the older son, Mihai hopes that surgical intervention for his ailing father will restore the family's harmony. Accompanied by Emil, the younger brother, they are caught in the aftermath of the Prague Spring, which alters their plans. Suddenly, they find themselves on the other side of the Iron Curtain in West Germany. In just a few hours, they have to decide: to stay or to go back home?

Unlikely friends in a melting pot of confusion. Simon Murray fights for the French Foreign Legion. Pascal Dupont fights for himself. War torn men question honour, hope, morality...because you can desert everything...except yourself.

Bernie Lootz (William H. Macy) is a long-time "cooler" at the Shangri-La casino in Las Vegas: he is paid to bring his black cloud to any table where a gambler is on a roll. But when Bernie's luck starts changing for the better--thanks in part to a pretty cocktail waitress--he suddenly loses his cooling talents, incurring the ire of the casino owner in the process.

Based on a true story. Eccentric, brilliant lawyer James Laughlin (Al Pacino) boldly accepts the case to defend American entertainer Mildred Gillars (Meadow Williams) from ten counts of treason charged by the US government regardless of the inevitable backlash from his country. During WWII, Mildred became a powerful weapon in the hands of the Nazis and was forced to sing defeatist war propaganda to US soldiers based in Europe. Terrorized and raped by Joseph Goebbels, Hitler's right-hand man, Mildred broadcasts hate-filled messages in order to survive the dark and dangerous world of the Third Reich. Despite attempting to murder Goebbels, Mildred is eventually captured by American authorities and sent to trial where, against all odds, Laughlin struggles to redeem her reputation and maintain his own.

People You May Know follows Jed, a 30-something introvert who has managed to abstain from social media until now. When prompted with the gargantuan task of defining who he is, he realizes the life he can fake is much more interesting than the life he actually leads.

Modes fotogrāfs ar neārstējamu vēzi izvēlas mirt viens, sagatavojot citus dzīvot pēc viņa, nevis paildzināt neizbēgamo ar ķīmijterapiju vai ļauties līdzjūtībai no tiem, kas viņu pazīst.

Jaunā Adelaina, būdama vien 29 gadus veca, iekļūst autoavārijā, pēc kuras iegūst spēju nenovecot. Stāsts turpinās par viņu nu jau 80 gadu vecumā, Adelaina dzīvo vientulībā un noslēgtībā, neļaujot sevi ietekmēt apkārtējai pasaulei. Adelainas meita ir vienīgā, kura zina viņas noslēpumu. Pēc ilgajiem gadiem Adelaina sastop vīrieti, ar kuru kopā vēlētos novecot. Viņa atkal vēlas dzīvot un mīlēt, taču brīdī, kad viņas noslēpumu varētu atklāt, Adelaina pieņem lēmumu, kas izmainīs viņas dzīvi.
Vīrieti sāk vajāt pagātne - viņš saņem noslēpumainu mantojumu, kas liek viņam pārdomāt savu pašreizējo dzīves situāciju.

Endija Gudriča dzīve apgriežas kājām gaisā, kad viņa sieva dodas uz rehabilitāciju, atstājot viņu vienu ar viņu mazajiem bērniem. Endijs paļaujas uz savu meitu Greisu no pirmās laulības un pamazām kļūst par tēvu, kāda viņai nekad nav bijis.
Brīdī, kad liktenis viņus saved kopā, Almutas lielais sapnis ir kļūt par veiksmīgāko šefpavāri, bet romantiskais Tobiass joprojām nevar atgūties no sāpīgas šķiršanās.

1928. gadā horeogrāfe Ida Rubinšteina Parīzē pasūtīja Morisam Ravēlam mūziku savam nākamajam baletam. Esot iedvesmas krīzē, komponists izvērtē savu dzīvi un nolemj veltīties universāla šedevra - "Bolero" - radīšanai.

Pēc sava drauga pieķeršanas neuzticībā, Marta kļūst mazliet neprātīga. Bet tad viņa iepazīstas ar Frānsisu. Viņš škiet īstais, ideālais vīrtietis, ja vien.. viņš nebūtu profesionāls slepkava. Kad Marta sāk apjaust, ka viņas jaunais puisis nejoko, sacīdams "es iziešu ārā, lai kādu novāktu", lietas kļūst vēl sarežģītākas. Izrādās Frānsisu vajā kriminālie grupēji, kas ir arī viņa iepriekšējie darba devēji. Līķiem krājoties kaudzē, Martai jāizlemj vai viņa grib bēg ko kājas nes vai kļūt par cienīgu partneri savam pusim-slepkavam.

Ollijs Kross ir jauns feldšeris, kurš strādā Ņujorkas nakts maiņā kopā ar pieredzējušu un nelokāmu partneri Džīnu Rutkovski. Katrs 911 izsaukums bieži ir bīstams un neparedzams, ik dienu liekot viņu dzīvības uz spēles, lai palīdzētu citiem.
Seriāls stāsta par četriem bijušajiem ASV armijas specvienības karavīriem, kuri, netaisnīgi apsūdzēti noziegumā, bēg no militārās policijas un palīdz cilvēkiem, kuri nonākuši nelaimē.

Apsēsts ar valdītkāri, karalis Hiperions grib iznīcināt cilvēku rasi un gāzt Olimpa dievus, kuri ir bezspēcīgi pretoties viņam. Šim nolūkam viņš atbrīvo Titānus no tūkstošgadu ieslodzījuma. Vienīgā cerība uz pestīšanu ir varonis Tēsejs. Nāvīgā cīņā ar Titāniem varoni atbalsta praviete Fedra, vergs Stavros un pats Zevs, bet šķiet, ka Hiperiona spēks ir neuzvarams. Vai Olimpa dievi tiks gāzti?

Arheoloģiskās ekspedīcijas laikā Buvē salā Antarktīdā zinātnieku grupa nonāk divu leģendāru radību cīņas epicentrā. Drīz viņi saprot, ka uzvarēt var tikai viena suga.
Trīs labākie draugi nonākuši situācijā, kurā esam pabijuši mēs visi - tas apjukuma pilnais moments katrās attiecībās, kurā jāizlemj, kur tas vedīs tālāk.
Pēc veiksmīgas gladiatoru izbēgšanas Spartaks vada atbrīvoto vergu armiju, vienlaikus izvēloties starp personīgo atriebību pret Romas ģenerāli Glāberu un cīņu par brīvību.
Pragmatisks ASV jūras kājnieks savām acīm redz Vjetnamas kara dehumanizējošo ietekmi uz saviem kolēģiem - sākot no brutālajām apmācības nometnēm līdz asiņainajām ielu kaujām Huē.

Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

Two talented chefs go head-to-head for the chance to Beat Bobby Flay. To get to Bobby the chefs must first face off against each other, creating a spectacular dish with a secret ingredient of Bobby's choice. Judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro know Bobby's strengths and his weaknesses. Their goal: Pick the chef who has the skills to take down Bobby Flay in his own arena. The winning chef gets to challenge Bobby with his or her surprise signature dish. If Bobby goes down, the winner can tell the world, "I beat Bobby Flay!"

Tournament of Champions winner Chef Mei Lin brings her competitive edge to Bobby Flay's Triple Threat kitchen. As Michael Voltaggio's former protege, she's ready to show that the student can outcook the master and the rest of team Titan. Then, judge Stephanie Izard will decide if Mei Lin's winning streak has come to an end.

While Rome is a city steeped in tradition, the food scene is being updated with modern techniques and new flavor combinations. From pizza pies inspired by famous pastas to a trendy food market, Bobby Flay and Giada De Laurentiis explore how the food culture is evolving while still honoring the classics. Plus, they cook up some cutting-edge cuisine with a local Michelin star chef.

Featuring 24 talented and fearless chefs who take on 24 food challenges in 24 consecutive, non-stop hours, the 24-hour competition takes the chefs to the extreme, demanding they display the skills, creativity and stamina needed to be an elite chef.

In Food Network's series Kids Baking Championship, hosts and judges Duff Goldman and Valerie Bertinelli will lead eight talented kid bakers through challenges designed to find the most-impressive and creative young baker. In each challenge the contestants, ranging in age from 10 to 13, will be tested on their baking skills and originality as they whip up delectable desserts, including creative cakes, mouthwatering cookies and pastries.

Molly Yeh is a cookbook author who combines her country lifestyle with her Jewish and Chinese heritage to create the most delicious new dishes. A former big city girl, Yeh is multi talented, a successful blogger and classically trained musician, its food that ultimately stole her heart. Learn lots of tricks and tips with Yeh as she cooks up her personal favourite recipes for every occasion, from family visits to brunch with the girls to a classic farm supper! This show is an absolute treat.

Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

Traveling back in time has never tasted so good. In this battle of the Chopped: Time Capsule series, the competing chefs have to cook with foods that were popular in the 1960s. A certain soda and some sweet meat are part of the appetizer basket, but the clock seems to be the most difficult aspect of the challenge. In the second round, a crazy casserole demands the chefs' attention, and in the dessert round, both chefs seem to have a clear plan, but will all of their ideas make it to the plate?

After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

A reboot and spinoff of the classic Restaurant: Impossible. Hosted by chef Aarón Sánchez and restaurateur Jen Agg, the series focuses on rescuing struggling restaurants on the brink of failure using modern industry practices, a strict ticking clock, and a limited budget

Šreks apprecēja princesi Fionu, bet kļūt par Tāltālās karaļvalsts karali neietilpa viņa plānos. Taču kad viņa sievastēvs karalis Herolds saslima, Šrekam bija vai nu jāatrod piemērots kandidāts karaļa tronim, vai arī jāatsakās no klusās un mierīgās dzīves purvā, lai kāptu tronī. Tādēļ kopā ar labākajiem draugiem Ēzelīti un Runci Zābakos Šreks devās uzmeklēt to, kurš, viņaprāt, būtu karaļa troņa cienīgs – Fionas radinieku Ārtiju. Kamēr Šreks bija ceļā, Tāltālajā karaļvalstī notika trakas lietas: Daiļais princis kopā ar sliktajiem pasaku varoņiem iebruka pilsētā, lai sagrābtu varu.

Po (Džeks Bleks) satiek savu sen pazudušo tēvu Lī (Braiens Kranstons), un abi dodas uz rezervātu, kurā sastop dažus smieklīgus ekscentriķus. Tomēr, kad uzrodas noslēpumainais ļaundaris Kajs (Džeikejs Simonss) - ļauns bullis, kurš zog kung fu meistaru dzīvības spēku - Po ir jāapmāca savi neveiklie sugas brāļi kung fu kaujas mākslā.

Animācijas filma "Lego" klucīšu stilā par Farela Viljamsa dzīvi. Filmā, kurā galvenās lomas ierunājis pats Farels Viljamss (Pharrell Williams), kā arī Kendriks Lamārs (Kendrick Lamar) un Džastins Timberleiks (Justin Timberlake), ķieģelīti pa ķieģelītim tiek pārskatīta mākslinieka karjera.

Pagājis gads, kopš Spensers un viņa draugi Marta, Fridžs un Betānija atrada veco videospēli Džumandži, un nu viņi katrs devušies savu ceļu. Tomēr noslēpumainās galda spēles spēkam nav robežu, un nemanot četrinieks no jauna nonāk bīstamajā, mistikas apvītajā valstībā. Tiesa, šoreiz spēle ir mainījusies. Džumandži apdraud varens pretinieks, un tas šo pasauli alkst iznīcināt. Spēlē iesprostotos sagaida lieli izaicinājumi, un, lai uzveiktu ļaundari, viņiem būs jāspēj sadarboties. Varoņu ceļš vedīs pāri tuksnešiem, džungļiem, oāzēm un sniegotiem kalniem – vai viņiem maz būs pa spēkam no turienes izkļūt dzīviem?

Laipni lūgti viesnīcā "Transilvānija", Drakulas krāšņajā pieczobu kūrortā, kurā monstri var izbaudīt nesteidzīgu atpūtu. Ir pienākusi īpaša nedēļas nogale, kuras laikā Drakula ir ielūdzis ciemos dažus no saviem labākajiem draugiem. Ir plānots svinēt Drakulas meitas Meivisas pilngadību – 118. dzimšanas dienu. Uzņemt tik kuplu viesu pulku Drakulas ģimenei nav problēma. Tomēr jukas izceļas, kad viesnīcā ieklīst parasts puisis un ieskatās viņa meitā.

Jaunajā, pilnībā animētajā "Smurfu" sērijā mūsu varoņi atrod noslēpumainu karti un dodas briesmu pilnajā piedzīvojumā, lai meklētu zudušo ciematu. Ceļš smurfus vedīs cauri noslēpumainam mežam, kur dzīvo maģiskas būtnes, bet viņiem pa pēdām sekos ļaunais burvis Gargamelis. Smurfi pat nenojauš, ka, izejot cauri visiem pārbaudījumiem, viņi atklās smurfu lielāko noslēpumu.

Skrats netīšām izraisa kontinentālu kataklizmu, kuras rezultātā Menijs tiek nošķirts no Elijas un Persikas. Viņš atrodas uz aisberga kopā ar Djego, Sidu un Omīti, taču apņemas atgriezties mājās. Pēc šiem satriecošajiem notikumiem Sids satiek sen neredzētus ģimenes locekļus, turklāt draugiem būs jātiek galā ar dažādiem jauniem personāžiem, kuri apņēmušies liegt viņiem atgriezties mājās.

Mailss Moraless atgriežas uz ekrāniem nākamajā ar Oskaru apbalvotās Zirnekļpasaules sāgas nodaļā. Varenais piedzīvojums nogādās Zirnekļcilvēku no Bruklinas draudzīgās apkaimes pāri Zirnekļpasaulei, lai viņš apvienotu spēkus ar Gvenu Steisiju un jauno zirnekļļaužu komandu un stātos pretī ļaundarim, par kuru spēcīgāku viņi vēl nav satikuši.

Četri vidusskolēni atrod vecu spēļu konsoli ar līdz šim neredzētu videospēli džumandži. Viņi iesaistās šajā spēlē, kas norisinās džungļos, un iemiesojas pašu izraudzītajos avataros. Jaunieši apjauš, ka džumandži ir kas vairāk par spēli, tā ir cīņa par izdzīvošanu. Lai uzvarētu spēlē, viņiem jādodas bīstamākajā piedzīvojumā mūžā, jāatklāj Alana Periša pirms 20 gadiem atstātās pēdas un jāmaina priekšstats pašiem par sevi, pretējā gadījumā viņi paliks ieslēgti spēlē uz visiem laikiem...
Trešā filma parodija par slepeno aģentu OSS 117.

Jaunu rakstnieci (Ajo Edebiri) uzaicina uz nomaļu savrupnamu, kurā mājo leģendāra popzvaigzne (Džons Malkovičs), kurš noslēpumaini pazuda pirms 30 gadiem. Zvaigznes lišķu un apreibināto žurnālistu kulta ieskauta, sieviete attopas viņa viltīgā plāna epicentrā.

Amerikāņu ģimenes bezrūpīgā dzīve eksotikā un pārpilnībā kādā no Dienvidaustrumāzijas valstīm vienā brīdī kļūst par īstu elli. Valstī notiek apvērsums – dumpinieku spēki sāk cīņu pret valsts militārajiem spēkiem un sākas anarhija, kuras karstumā izskan aicinājumi nogalināt visus ārzemniekus – gan vīriešus, gan sievietes un bērnus

Uzzinājusi, ka mīļotais vīrietis ir precējies, Kārlija Vitena cenšas sakārtot savu sagrauto dzīvi. Kad viņa nejauši sastop mīļotā piekrāpto sievu, Kārlija saprot, ka viņām ir daudz kopīga, un ļaunākā ienaidniece kļūst par viņas labāko draudzeni. Kad atklājas vēl viena dēka, visas trīs sievietes apvieno spēkus, lai kaltu atriebības plānu.

Hloja un viņas mamma pārvācas – jau ATKAL! Turklāt viņas pārvācas uz necilu, vecu māju, kas pilna ar dārza rūķiem. Drīz Hloja gan atklāj, ka šī māja slēpj biedējošu noslēpumu. Kādu dienu pēc skolas Hloja kopā ar kaimiņu Liamu atklāj, ka rūķi patiesībā ir dzīvi! Kā izrādās, jau gadiem rūķi ir sargājuši planētu no draudīgiem maziem monstriem, kuri iebrukuši mājā caur portālu, kas ved uz citu pasauli. Kad vienīgais līdzeklis, kas varētu palīdzēt uzveikt monstrus, skolā nonāk nepareizajās rokās, Hlojai un Liamam jāsadarbojas ar rūķiem, lai cīnītos pret mazo negantnieku iebrukumu un glābtu pasauli!

Žoslēns ir veiksmīgs biznesmenis, toties mīlas dzīvē – patmīlīgs brunču mednieks. Kad viņš mēģina jau atkal savaldzināt jaunu sievieti, izliekoties, ka ir ratiņkrēslā, viņa iepazīstina Žoslēnu ar savu māsu, kura patiešām piesaistīta dzīvei ratiņkrēslā.

p.d: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. Tarek is a self-proclaimed real estate genius with determination and drive. Christina is Tarek's picture-perfect wife, who Tarek's friends still can't believe he landed. In each episode of "Flip or Flop", Tarek and Christina flip a new property. From the nail-biting purchase at auction, to the frustrating renovations and maddening showings, to the giddy acceptance of an offer, we'll follow along as these two relatively novice flippers try their hand at the toughest game in town. From purchase to resale, weaving their personal lives within the story of the flip. From paying cash, sight unseen, for a property at auction, through the hapless remodeling process, to the frantic sale, this young couple is putting everything they have into this venture.

Jessie and Tina Rodriguez are living the American dream, taking their passion for vintage homes and turning them into successful flips. In each episode of Vintage Flip , this creative couple will find, buy, restore and market a vintage home. You never know what might be hiding behind hundred year-old walls!

Jessie and Tina dive into restoring a 1923 art deco bungalow in Ontario, CA. While the property is in a great neighborhood, the house itself is a confusing mishmash of styles. Will Jessie and Tina be able to sift through decades of renovations and bring this charming bungalow back to its 1920s roots?

Jessie and Tina work to restore a Tudor Cottage home from 1923 in their hometown of Claremont, CA. Converted into various businesses over the years, the flip is completely gutted on the inside and barely resembles a home. The two set off to bring this former business back to its original, charming roots, but not without some unexpected challenges along the way.

Joanna Gaines, renowned for her grand makeovers, takes on an entirely new challenge in 'Mini Reni.' With only a week to transform three rooms, she faces the clock and a tight budget in each thrilling episode. Can she rejuvenate these tired spaces with her signature touch? Watch as Joanna breathes new life into every nook and cranny, masterfully combining elegance with affordability.

From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

For the first time, the "Pawn Stars" are hitting the road to visit some of America's most exciting places in search of historical finds and impressive collectible objects in the new 8-part series "Pawn Stars Do America." Each two-hour episode follows Rick Harrison, Corey Harrison and Austin "Chumlee" Russell as they step out of the World Famous Gold & Silver Pawn Shop in Las Vegas to connect with fans in eight different cities and acquire some of the most remarkable items imaginable.

Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. A&E presents the new original real-life series "Storage Wars," which follows professional buyers and their teams as they scour repossessed storage units in search of hidden treasure. Part gamblers, part detectives, these auction pros have found everything from coffins to the world's most valuable comic book collection, paying as little as ten dollars for items valued in the millions. Each episode of "Storage Wars" follows a group of bidders as they get a quick peek inside the units, aided only by the beam of a flashlight. They then must assess on the spot if the unit is worth a bid and how high they will actually go to grasp the gold. The high-stakes fun begins as we see if the resulting buy is full of mostly trash... or true treasure. Driven by Dan Dotson, one of the most successful and outrageous auctioneers in the country, the cast of buyers is as colorful and varied as the treasures they uncover.

Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.
